T0532.title: Runner
T0532.definition: An execution environment that runs CI/CD jobs, build scripts, tests, and deployment tasks.
T0532.description: Runners execute pipeline jobs and often access source code, artifact repositories, deployment credentials, and internal networks. Misconfigured shared or self-hosted runners can let attackers steal secrets, persist backdoors, or move laterally through malicious jobs. Controls include tenant isolation, network restrictions, workspace cleanup, and limiting privileged mode.
T0532.usageExample: Assess Runner related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
